aviation_incidents.summary: 交通部民用航空局表示，「2026年飛航安全管理國際峯會」今日正式登場，會中邀集約200位專家及高階主管與會。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Taiwan aviation safety summit opens; CAA points to three areas for resilience
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration said the 2026 International Flight Safety Management Summit opened, bringing together about 200 experts and senior executives.

aviation_incidents.headline: 美國航空空中巴士A319乘客涉不當觸碰，警方接應航機
aviation_incidents.summary: 一名乘客在美國航空空中巴士A319（ICAO機型代碼A319）上，涉嫌對同座乘客有不當觸碰。報導摘要稱，該航班於中午飛越威奇托時，空服員在接獲相關通報後將兩名乘客分開；報導標題則稱，航機由警方接應。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Police Meet American Airlines Airbus A319 After Alleged Passenger Groping
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Simple Flying reported that a passenger aboard an American Airlines Airbus A319 (ICAO type code A319) allegedly groped a seatmate during a midday flight over Wichita. Its summary says flight attendants separated the two passengers after a reported inappropriate touch, while the headline says police met the aircraft.

aviation_incidents.summary: Simple Flying 的標題報導波士頓發生復飛，並稱一架未獲準進入跑道的 Etihad 波音 787 進入了跑道。標題同時提到復飛與跑道進入，但這裡不將兩者寫成已確認的因果關係。

aviation_incidents.headline: LATAM Airlines空中巴士A320在利馬機場起火後疏散
aviation_incidents.summary: LATAM Airlines一架空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320），註冊編號CC-BFS，於2026年10月19日在祕魯利馬的Jorge Chávez International Airport（LIM）滑行前往跑道時，發動機起火，機上人員隨後撤離。報導指出，飛機當時準備執行LA 2302航班，目的地為Piura（PIU）；左側CFM56發動機起火，原因尚待查明。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: LATAM Airlines A320 evacuated after engine fire at Lima airport
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A LATAM Airlines Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320), registration CC-BFS, was evacuated after an engine fire while on the tarmac at Jorge Chávez International Airport (LIM) in Lima, Peru, on October 19, 2026. The aircraft was taxiing toward the runway as it prepared to operate flight LA 2302 to Piura (PIU). The report said the fire began in the port-side CFM56 engine; its cause has not been established.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華信航空提貨運價格脫鉤及敬老優惠票總量管制構想
taiwan_aviation.summary: 華信航空董事長陳大鈞表示，理性上國內線票價應調漲，但政府照顧民眾是另一個考量。報導指出，國內線票價已超過20年未調漲。總經理莊明哲提出貨運價格脫鉤，以及對敬老優惠票實施總量管制的構想。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: 華信航空 proposes cargo pricing changes and a cap on senior discount tickets
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: 華信航空 chairman 陳大鈞 said there is a rational case for raising domestic fares, while government support for the public is another consideration. Domestic airfares have not increased for more than 20 years. General manager 莊明哲 proposed decoupling cargo pricing and setting a total limit on discounted senior tickets.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空增加布拉格、鳳凰城及安大略航班
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空表示，鳳凰城、布拉格及安大略航點已增班。布拉格航線由每週3班增至4班；鳳凰城及安大略則由每週4班增至5班。星宇航空公關長梁文龍表示，這些航點的載客率與票價表現持穩向上。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: 星宇航空 Adds Flights to Prague, Phoenix and Ontario
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: 星宇航空 said it has increased service to Phoenix, Prague and Ontario. Prague service rose from three to four flights a week, while Phoenix and Ontario service increased from four to five weekly flights. The airline’s public relations chief, 梁文龍, said passenger load factors and fares at these destinations had remained stable and were trending upward.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空預計2027年底機隊增至48架 明年營收估增逾四成
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空公關長梁文龍表示，機隊規模預計2026年底達42架，2027年底前增加至48架。今年11月至12月預計交付4架飛機，包括1架A350-1000、1架A330-900及2架A321neo；2027年底前預計再交付6架，包括4架A321neo及2架A350-1000。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux Airlines Expects Fleet to Reach 48 Aircraft by End-2027
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux Airlines public relations chief Liang Wen-lung said the carrier expects its fleet to reach 42 aircraft by the end of 2026 and 48 by the end of 2027. It expects four aircraft to be delivered in November and December this year: one A350-1000, one A330-900 and two A321neo. A further six aircraft are expected by the end of 2027, comprising four A321neo and two A350-1000.

taiwan_aviation.headline_en: STARLUX Plans Taipei–Sydney–Auckland Service in 2027 with A330neo
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: STARLUX Airlines plans to connect Taipei Taoyuan (TPE), Sydney (SYD) and Auckland (AKL) in 2027. Sydney Airport announced on June 2, 2026, that Sydney would be the carrier's first Australian destination, with an onward service to Auckland.

taiwan_aviation.summary: 國防部長顧立雄表示，臺中機場的無人機防禦系統（UDS）已完成驗收，預計10月底以前可發揮相關功能。顧立雄說，待複驗完成、空軍各基地陸續建置完畢後，UDS可用於幹擾第一、二型無人機。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taichung Airport Drone Defense System Accepted, Expected to Function by Month-End
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: CNA reported that Defense Minister 顧立雄 said the drone defense system (UDS) at Taichung Airport has completed acceptance. He said it should be able to perform its functions before the end of October. 顧立雄 also said configuration changes to include the 5.17 GHz band in the system's jamming frequencies began this year.

taiwan_aviation.summary_en: A Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft has deployed to Japan to take part in Exercise Keen Sword, AeroTime reports. The exercise is running from October 19 to 29, 2026, and involves around 260 aircraft.

international_aviation.headline_en: Ukraine's 92nd Brigade reports wounded serviceman evacuated by heavy-lift drone
international_aviation.summary_en: Ukraine’s 92nd Separate Assault Brigade posted on its official Telegram channel that a wounded serviceman had been evacuated from a position by aerial drone. international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa plans three weekly Columbus–Frankfurt flights from May 2027
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa plans to begin service between John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH) and Frankfurt Airport (FRA) on 5 May 2027. The airline plans to operate three flights per week, on Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays. The service is scheduled to connect Columbus with Lufthansa’s Frankfurt hub.

international_aviation.summary: 聯邦航空總署（FAA）表示，已核發波音737 MAX-10的認證。FAA指出，修訂型號證書確認該機符合所有適用的設計與安全要求；另更新生產限制紀錄，授權生產該機型。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA certifies Boeing 737 MAX-10 and authorizes production
international_aviation.summary_en: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) says it has issued certification for Boeing’s 737 MAX-10. The FAA said its amended type certificate confirms that the aircraft complies with all applicable design and safety requirements. It also issued an updated Production Limitation Record authorizing production.

international_aviation.headline: 美國海軍從航母遠端控制MQ-25A無人機，相隔逾2,100英里
international_aviation.summary: 美國海軍表示，已從在太平洋航行的航母遠端控制波音MQ-25A Stingray無人機；航母與位於伊利諾州的飛機相隔逾2,100英里。海軍於10月19日宣佈這項里程碑，稱這是航母在海上航行時首次與MQ-25A建立此類控制連線。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Navy remotely controls MQ-25A Stingray from carrier over 2,100 miles away
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Navy said on 19 October that it had remotely controlled a Boeing MQ-25A Stingray from an aircraft carrier sailing in the Pacific. The carrier was more than 2,100 miles from the aircraft in Illinois. The Navy described the connection as the first of its kind between an MQ-25A and a carrier underway at sea.

international_aviation.headline: Bristow選定挪威五處場址 規劃2027年混合電動飛機示範
international_aviation.summary: Bristow Group、Electra、Avinor及Civil Aviation Authority of Norway（CAA Norway）已選定挪威五處場址，規劃於2027年進行混合電動飛機示範。首趟示範飛行預計於2027年第三季進行。計畫將使用Electra的EL2技術示範機，評估混合電動飛機在不同航空環境中的運作方式，包括既有國際機場、短跑道設施及沒有傳統跑道的地點。
international_aviation.headline_en: Bristow selects five Norwegian sites for 2027 aircraft demonstrations
international_aviation.summary_en: Bristow Group, Electra, Avinor and the Civil Aviation Authority of Norway (CAA Norway) have selected five locations in Norway for hybrid-electric aircraft demonstrations planned for 2027. The first demonstration flight is planned for the third quarter of 2027. The programme will use Electra’s EL2 technology demonstrator to explore operations across established international airports, short-runway facilities and locations without conventional runways.
entities: Civil Aviation Authority of Norway (CAA Norway)
